description: Individual NFL predictions: who made them, when (claimedAt is the publication date), a short excerpt of the wording, the grade (accuracy 0-100, or pending) and the grading arithmetic. Filter by pundit, outlet, prediction type, team, player, season, verdict (hit is 80+, close is 40-79, miss is under 40) and claim dates. 25 rows a page; pass page for more.

claimedAfter.description: Only takes published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

claimedBefore.description: Only takes published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

outletSlug.description: Only takes published by this outlet.

seasonYear.description: Only takes tied to this NFL season.

verdict.description: hit is 80+, close 40-79, miss under 40; graded is any grade.

name: list_takes
title: Find individual NFL takes
